 class Author(Thing):
     """Class to represent /type/author objects in OL."""
 
+    def merge_remote_ids(
+        self, incoming_ids: dict[str, str]
+    ) -> tuple[dict[str, str], int]:
+        """Return the combined IDs and number of IDs already on this author.
+
+        The author is left unchanged so callers can save the merged result with
+        the rest of their import after all conflicts have been checked.
+        """
+        merged = dict(self.dict().get('remote_ids') or {})
+        matching = 0
+        for source, incoming_id in incoming_ids.items():
+            if source in merged:
+                if merged[source] != incoming_id:
+                    raise AuthorRemoteIdConflictError(
+                        f"Conflicting {source} remote ID for author {self.key}: "
+                        f"{merged[source]!r} != {incoming_id!r}"
+                    )
+                matching += 1
+            else:
+                merged[source] = incoming_id
+        return merged, matching
+
